description: This file defines the interface MerchantConfigurationService, which declares methods for managing merchant configurations within the system. It extends a generic entity service and provides methods to retrieve, save, and list merchant configuration data linked to merchant stores.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationService
classes.description: An interface that extends SalesManagerEntityService, providing methods for retrieval and management of MerchantConfiguration and MerchantConfig data related to MerchantStore.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieve a merchant configuration based on a key and store, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save or update a MerchantConfiguration entity within the system.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: List all MerchantConfiguration objects associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: List configurations filtered by type and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Retrieve the MerchantConfig object for a specific store.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Save or update MerchantConfig data for a specific store.
